title: OPS-01 Input Radiometric Value Domain Representation Decision Record

current_physical_state.observed_values: raw intensity / DN-domain amplitude values as stored in GeoTIFF files

RAW_AMPLITUDE_DN.meaning: Uncalibrated digital numbers representing detected SAR amplitude signal
RAW_AMPLITUDE_DN.scientific_consequences: Values are sensor-gain dependent; backscatter across different scenes may not be directly comparable in physical units
RAW_AMPLITUDE_DN.pros: Requires zero transformation assumptions; uses raw observed bits
RAW_AMPLITUDE_DN.cons: Distorted dynamic range, high speckle skew, uncalibrated radiometry

CALIBRATED_SIGMA0.meaning: Normalized radar cross section (backscatter coefficient) in linear scale
CALIBRATED_SIGMA0.required_source_data: Sentinel-1 L1 calibration lookup table (LUT) from product XML metadata
CALIBRATED_SIGMA0.scientific_consequences: Physically meaningful unit representing ground reflectivity; comparable across acquisitions and sensors
CALIBRATED_SIGMA0.pros: Scientifically rigorous, physically defensible for oceanographic modeling
CALIBRATED_SIGMA0.cons: Requires extracting and applying XML calibration vectors to raw tile coordinates; correspondence hypothesis must be validated under calibration

DECIBEL_SIGMA0_DB.required_source_data: Calibrated sigma0 or logarithmic amplitude transformation
DECIBEL_SIGMA0_DB.scientific_consequences: Compresses wide dynamic range of radar backscatter into near-Gaussian distribution suitable for standard neural network training
DECIBEL_SIGMA0_DB.pros: Well-behaved distributions for gradient descent; standard in remote sensing literature
DECIBEL_SIGMA0_DB.cons: Amplifies low-signal noise floor; introduces non-linear distortion if eps is misconfigured

closure_requirements: Do not select representation in Phase 8-P3-C1
Formally design ablation experiment in EXP-07 protocol comparing raw DN vs log-transformed vs calibrated sigma0
Validate radiometric calibration metadata pipeline before training
